note: VIS-03's perception classes by FND-07 entity kind (Gameplay §5.2). size: miner and large arrive as anonymous tokens in the fringe (0.12-0.30); small things need 0.30 and are never tokens; none is never perceived as an entity (gates, doors and collapse points are geometry). footprint: the square of tiles whose brightest seen tile lights a large entity. motionless: a large kind that always shares the motionless token class (the heap of coats); the Moth joins it while the motionless flag is set (asleep). identity_min overrides vision.identity_light_min for a kind. The Tapper itself is none: it lives in the rock and is never sent (CRT-08); only its arm leaves a wall face, as TAPPER_ARM (CRT-09), a small thing seen at 0.30. Tubs and the drum gear have no entity kind yet.
